C-59.Name: Print and Export to PDF as two clean flows: ⌘P goes straight to the system print panel; Export to PDF writes a file through a save dialog with no print panel — macOS (WKWebView) and Windows (WebView2)
C-59.Summary: User report 2026-10-18: Print and Export to PDF are tangled — Print first opens the export-settings dialog and then the print panel; Export to PDF opens the same settings dialog and then the print panel again (a PDF only via the panel's "Save as PDF"). Root cause: C-18 routed both through one native command (mt_print_webview → WKWebView print panel) behind the export-settings dialog. On Windows both fail with "print panel is macOS-only". This change separates the flows and makes them work on both platforms.

Problem.Description: File → Print… emits showExportDialog('print') and, after OK, invokes mt_print_webview; File → Export to PDF… emits showExportDialog('pdf') and the store's _EXPORT_PDF invokes the same mt_print_webview. Users see "export, then print" for Print and "export, then print again" for PDF, and Windows users get an error for both. m052_print.rs returns Err on non-macOS.

Goals.R-1: Print… (⌘P) opens the system print panel directly — no export-settings dialog. The print container is rendered with the last-used export options (theme, margins, header/footer, TOC; defaults on first use), so printed output matches the app; the container is cleared after the panel closes.
Goals.R-2: Export to PDF… keeps the export-settings dialog (page size, orientation, margins, header/footer, TOC, theme), then shows a native save dialog (default name = document name or first heading, .pdf), then writes the PDF silently — no print panel. Success notice with the file name; cancel at either dialog writes nothing.
Goals.R-3: macOS backend: a new command mt_export_pdf(path, pageOptions) in m052 runs the WKWebView print operation in save-to-file mode (NSPrintInfo jobDisposition = NSPrintSaveJob, NSPrintJobSavingURL = the chosen path, paper size/orientation/margins from pageOptions, showsPrintPanel/showsProgressPanel = false) on the main thread; returns after the file exists or with a structured error. Pagination and print CSS are the same as the panel path. MAS sandbox: writes only to the user-selected save-dialog URL.
Goals.R-4: Windows backend: mt_export_pdf uses WebView2 ICoreWebView2_7::PrintToPdf (page size, orientation, margins via ICoreWebView2PrintSettings) and awaits its completion handler; mt_print_webview on Windows opens the WebView2 print dialog (ICoreWebView2_16::ShowPrintUI, browser print UI) instead of erroring. Linux keeps an explicit unsupported error.
Goals.R-5: Menu, command palette and help texts name the two actions clearly; the export-settings dialog title says "Export to PDF" for pdf (and is never shown for print); strings in all ten locales.
Goals.R-6: Tests: unit (store EXPORT pdf calls save dialog then mt_export_pdf with the path and pageOptions; print command never emits showExportDialog; cancel paths), e2e (⌘P / menu Print invokes mt_print_webview without the settings dialog; Export to PDF shows the dialog then plugin:dialog|save then mt_export_pdf, never mt_print_webview), Rust (pageOptions → paper size/orientation mapping; path validation rejects empty/non-.pdf). grace lint 0; graph M-052 and verification V-M-052 updated.

Constraints.Item: No new crates: macOS uses the existing cocoa/objc dependencies; Windows uses webview2-com (already in the root Cargo.lock via wry) declared under the existing cfg(target_os = "windows") section; no new capabilities beyond the existing dialog save.
The webview handle is reached through tauri's with_webview (PlatformWebview) on the main thread; no unsafe global state.
App Store build stays sandbox-safe: no writes outside the user-selected file, no external binaries.
Every GRACE-governed edit ships MODULE_CONTRACT/MAP/CHANGE_SUMMARY; grace lint --assertions current = 0.

NonGoals.Item: A PDF engine of our own, pandoc, or headless Chrome.
Per-page header/footer templates beyond what the existing export options already render in the print container.

AffectedAreas.Item: src-tauri/src/m052_print.rs (mt_export_pdf + Windows print), src-tauri/src/lib.rs (command registration), src-tauri/Cargo.toml (windows target: webview2-com)

src/renderer/src/commands/index.js (file.print direct), src/renderer/src/components/editorWithTabs/editor.vue (handleExport print/pdf), src/renderer/src/store/editor.js (EXPORT pdf → save dialog + mt_export_pdf), src/renderer/src/components/exportSettings/index.vue (pdf-only, remembered options)

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1..R-6 done; npx vitest run green; Playwright print-export spec green on chromium + webkit; cargo check green for macOS and Windows targets (CI test.yml windows job); grace lint 0.

Live check on macOS (user): ⌘P shows only the print panel; Export to PDF shows settings → save dialog → a paginated PDF on disk, no print panel. Windows check via the CI-built installer or a Windows machine before release.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Invoke-order traces from e2e (print: no showExportDialog; pdf: dialog → save → mt_export_pdf, zero mt_print_webview); Rust option-mapping tests; a PDF written on macOS with the correct page count; Windows CI compile.

Assumptions.Assumption: WKWebView's printOperationWithPrintInfo honours NSPrintSaveJob with NSPrintJobSavingURL when run without panels (standard AppKit behaviour; verified live before merge).
tauri 2 with_webview exposes ICoreWebView2Controller on Windows and the WKWebView pointer on macOS.
